page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number 176 at left. Main text in three columns of Greek verb paradigms: left column of Latin-labelled forms (Statuisse, Statuisse, Statuam, Siftatua, Siftatuisse, Siftatuero) with Greek forms in a second column and further Greek forms in a third column; headings SVBIVNCTIVVS and sub-headings Praesens, Perfectum, Infinitum, Futurum set in the centre. A small catchword-like mark at the lower right margin.
page.notes: Greek forms are transcribed from the scan with uncertainty in accents and some letters; the marginal Latin labels (Statuisse, Statuam, Siftatua, Siftatuisse, Siftatuero) are set in the left margin beside their rows. Some faint show-through from the reverse page appears in the right margin and is omitted. The mark at lower right is a signature-like sign and is not transcribed.
